format.description: Consecutive per-second Supra DORA-2 OracleProofV2 proofs for pairs [0,1,3,10,49] on BSC testnet (chainId 97). Fork chain 97 at blockBeforeFirstProof.number (needs an archive-capable RPC, e.g. https://bsc-testnet-rpc.publicnode.com) and record proofs[] in order (one per second).
format.proofs: proofs[i].proof = raw bytes (0x hex) to pass to verifyOracleProofV2(bytes) / a CheckpointOracle. proofs[i].round = round start in ms (all 5 feeds share it); consecutive entries are exactly 1000 ms apart.
format.feed: committees[].feeds[] = {pair, price (decimal string, 10^decimals scaled), timestamp (ms), decimals, round (ms), leaf}. leaf = keccak256(LE32(pair) ++ LE128(price) ++ LE64(timestamp) ++ LE16(decimals) ++ LE64(round)) (38 bytes, little-endian), Merkle multiproof = OpenZeppelin MerkleProof.multiProofVerify (sorted-pair keccak256) over leaves in feed order.
format.verifyCall: eth_call of verifyOracleProofV2(proofs[0].proof) against the REAL chain at blockBeforeFirstProof.number and at the latest block when captured (read-only; nothing was sent).
format.receivedAtMs: local wall clock (NTP-synced, ~±30 ms) when the first response containing that round arrived (5 Hz polling => up to +200 ms quantisation).
